title: Olmec moves twice his speed
description: Olmec hops toward a player standing still, rising 8 pixels a step where his code sets 4, and drifts left 4 pixels a step where it sets at most 2. Over the player, he stops and slams down 10 and then 12 pixels a step, where it sets 5 to 6, and crushes him.
